turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I was wondering if you could tell us what brought you in to see us.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I just came in. I was a bit worried because I've been having this cough for around two years, which has been getting worse. But recently I've noticed that I see streaks of blood in the sputum that I'm producing. Before it just used to be like white but now I'm seeing over the last, I would say two months occasionally some streaks of blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and the cough started two years ago.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And, it's been gradually getting worse over that time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I would say so. It's getting more frequent and worse in nature.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And how much sputum are you bringing up an in a day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Probably like a, a couple teaspoons.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, is are you seeing like bright red blood when you're when you're coughing it up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh. In this it's kind of mixed into the sputum. I would say like, but it definitely is red.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And how much blood would you say that you're you're bringing up would be teaspoons? Or a Cup? Or?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No. It's just like a little streaks. It's not really significant, it doesn't feel like the whole production of the sputum, but just like little streaks that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and um is the cough worse, at any particular time of day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it definitely gets worse when I'm doing more activities and then also when I get like some viral infections. But other than that, it's pretty much always there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, anything that that makes it worse? You said some viral infections. Have you had a viral infection recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, like in the last two years, I've probably had two or three viral infections, just just just cold cold symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has there been anything that you've tried to make the cough better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've tried the Tylenol Cold, hasn't really worked. Tried just other over the counter medications, haven't really worked.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And prior to two years ago um, were you experiencing any similar symptoms like, uh, like this cough or bringing up blood before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: In the past, I've always had a somewhat of a cough like I have COPD. So I've always had a little bit of a cough here and there, but over the last two years I feel that it's been getting much worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been diagnosed with chronic bronchitis before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um and so with with this cough and now blood tinged sputum, have you been experiencing any other symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I do feel sometimes I get like more tired than I used to throughout the day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, sometimes I also feel more breathless on when I'm exerting myself more.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been having any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you lost any weight?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've actually lost a significant amount of weight. I would say within the last 1 and a 1/2 months probably lost like 8 to 10 pounds.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been trying to lose weight?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really I've just been sitting around like I can barely walk that much anymore too. I used to be able to walk at least 400 meters around the block, but now I can barely even go to the kitchen.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is this because of the shortness of breath when you are are exerting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that and I just start coughing so much that I just have to sit down.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um, and have you been having any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and how about and how is your appetite been?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I think it's been pretty much the same. Sometimes when I'm coughing a lot, I don't feel like eating, but other than that it's been around the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any runny nose or sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And then how about a loss of smell or a loss of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been having any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any heart palpitations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any wheezing when you're breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes I would say like when when, it gets worse when I'm exerting myself more, I I can get some wheezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you noticed any swelling in your feet or ankles?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright. And have you woken up at night extremely short of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I'm pretty fine during the night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright And, uh, have you been having any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any bowel problems like diarrhea or constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, any skin rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any joint pains or or muscle pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any weakness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not weakness, I'll just say more fatigue.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright so I know you told me a COPD, but do you have any other medical diagnosis?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have high blood pressure as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think I have high cholesterol too.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK. Do you take any medications regularly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so for the cholesterol taking Rosuvastatin and I forget what I'm taking for the blood pressure, but it's pretty well under control.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you use any inhalers for COPD?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I used to. I used to have I think like 3 different inhalers but haven't had to use them for more than 10 years now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what was the reason for not needing them anymore?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I just didn't have any symptoms for a pretty long time and my doc said like if I don't really need them then I could just stop.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any recent hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any allergies to medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any surgeries that you had in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No surgeries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, And are your vaccinations up to date?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yup.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and could you tell me a little bit about your social situation or living situation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so currently I'm just living by myself in an apartment. I've been there for more than 10 years now. Um, I am retired so I'm not working anymore. But yeah, that's that's me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, great um. What did you do previously for for work? Did you have any exposures for two chemicals or dusts or asbestos? Things like of that nature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yes, I worked in the steel factory for most of my working life. I think yeah, there might have been some exposures to chemicals and dust particles. Asbestos I don't think there was exposure, but definitely I may have lived in places that had asbestos. I mean, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how long have you been living where you you've been now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So this this is like the one I'm living in is a new place, but before that, I lived in another apartment for around five years and that was a pretty old building.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have any pets?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No pets, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um. And do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I smoke, I'd say around 20 cigarettes a day right now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and did you smoke more previously?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I think I've been smoking for almost like 40 years now and I used to smoke up to 30 cigarettes a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you smoke cannabis?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright. Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um just maybe a couple times a month. Nothing, nothing throughout the week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so do you use any recreational drugs like IV drugs or opioids or cocaine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright. And anybody in the family have any similar symptoms before like coughing up blood or?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No. Not that I know of. My father passed away from a heart attack when he was in his 60s. And I think my mother had a, um like I think one of the like, an arthritis. But yeah, like, but I think that was just like the one that you get with old age.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, like osteoarthritis?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah that that was the one.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any cancers in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, not that, one of my uncles had like um bladder cancer, but that's that's that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you have you traveled anywhere recently or been around any sick contacts? Possibly people anybody who's had tuberculosis or any infections?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been pretty much to myself over the last few months, so not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um. Was there anything that you're worried that this could be?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um Yeah, just the blood I kind of got scared maybe I thought like you know what if it's a cancer? One of my friends had lung cancer and I I know I've been smoking for most of my life, so that's something I was worried about.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, I can certainly see that the concern and I understand where you're coming from. I think it would be very reasonable to investigate that today. So we'll start with a chest CT along with some lab work and we will get a CBC and some electrolytes, also get an ECG as well to just check your heart and we will see what what the investigations show

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sounds good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and um, other things that um to think about this could be, uh, also like to COPD I know it's been going on a long time, but possibly could have a pneumonia that's been lingering on, particularly if it's a fungal type of infection and as well as things like you mentioned you possibly unsure if you've had an asbestos exposure in the past and stuff like that can possibly lead to scarring of the lung, and so all of these factors will be looked into.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sounds good. Thank you so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, you're welcome, thank you.
